scenes.caption: Installing Provenance Wiki on a Mac
scenes.say: This video shows you how to install Provenance Wiki on a Mac. It takes about ten minutes, and you don't need any technical knowledge. You can pause the video at any time.

scenes.caption: You need: a Mac with Apple silicon, the disk image, test photos and two API keys
scenes.say: Before you start, you need a Mac with Apple silicon, running mac O S fifteen, Sequoia, or later. You also need the Provenance Wiki disk image file, a few photographs of test documents, and two A P I keys: one from Anthropic, and one from Voyage A I. The tester instructions explain where to get them.

scenes.caption: Download the .dmg file from the shared folder
scenes.say: First, download the file ending in dot D M G from the shared folder. If your browser asks whether to allow the download, click Allow.

scenes.caption: Open your Downloads folder and double-click the .dmg file
scenes.say: When the download has finished, open your Downloads folder, and double-click the D M G file.

scenes.caption: Drag Provenance Wiki (Testing) onto the Applications folder
scenes.say: A window opens. Drag Provenance Wiki Testing onto the Applications folder in the same window. This copies the app to your Mac.

scenes.caption: Open Applications and double-click Provenance Wiki (Testing)
scenes.say: Now open your Applications folder, and double-click Provenance Wiki Testing.

scenes.caption: “Not Opened”: click Done. Do not click Move to Trash
scenes.say: The first time, mac O S says it could not verify the app. That's expected, because this testing version isn't signed by Apple yet. Click Done. Do not click Move to Trash.

scenes.caption: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway
scenes.say: Open System Settings, and choose Privacy and Security. Scroll down to the message about Provenance Wiki Testing, and click Open Anyway.

scenes.caption: Enter your Mac password, then click Open Anyway again
scenes.say: If you're asked, enter your Mac password, then click Open Anyway again. You only do this once for each version. After that, it opens like any other app.

scenes.caption: Provenance Wiki opens in your web browser, on your own computer
scenes.say: Provenance Wiki opens in your web browser. It runs on your own computer, not on a website. The welcome page has four steps.

scenes.caption: Step 1: Click “Create my archive here”
scenes.say: Step one: where to store your archive. The suggested folder is fine for most people. Click Create my archive here.

scenes.caption: Short on space? Choose “Choose another folder” and pick a larger drive
scenes.say: If your Mac's drive is nearly full, choose Choose another folder instead, and pick a folder on a larger or external drive. Avoid folders that sync to the cloud, like iCloud Drive or Dropbox.

scenes.caption: Your archive is ready
scenes.say: Your archive is now set up. It shows where it's stored, and how much space is free.

scenes.caption: Step 2: Paste your Anthropic key and click Save. Then do the same for Voyage AI
scenes.say: Step two: your A P I keys. Copy your Anthropic key, paste it into the first box, and click Save. Then do the same for your Voyage A I key, in the second box.

scenes.caption: Click “Test connection” to check each key
scenes.say: Each key now shows Saved. Click Test connection to check that it works. Your keys are kept in your Mac's Keychain, not in a file.

scenes.caption: Step 3: Read what leaves your computer
scenes.say: Step three explains what information leaves your computer. Please read it before you add any confidential material.

scenes.caption: Step 4: Click “Open photos folder”
scenes.say: Step four: add your photos. Click Open photos folder.

scenes.caption: Copy your photographs into this folder (JPEG, PNG, TIFF or WebP)
scenes.say: A Finder window opens. Copy your photographs into it. They can be jay peg, P N G, tiff, or web P files, with one photograph per page. iPhone photos in H E I C format need to be exported as jay peg first.

scenes.caption: Click “I’ve added photos: check again”
scenes.say: Back in your browser, click: I've added photos, check again. It shows how many new photographs are ready.

scenes.caption: Don’t forget the Source: where these documents come from (required)
scenes.say: Now fill in the Source: the archive or collection these documents come from. Don't skip this. It's required, and it's saved with every document, so you can cite it later.

scenes.caption: Click “Ingest Photos”. When it’s done, open the Gallery
scenes.say: Click Ingest Photos. Each photograph is read by Anthropic, so this can take a little while. When it's done, open the Gallery to see your documents.

scenes.caption: Find the P icon in the menu bar, at the top right of your screen
scenes.say: A small P icon appears in the menu bar, at the top right of your screen.

scenes.caption: Click it to reopen the app, open your photos, or Quit
scenes.say: Click it to open Provenance Wiki again, open your photos folder, or quit. Closing the browser tab doesn't stop the app. To stop it, choose Quit.

scenes.caption: Next time, open it from Applications or Launchpad
scenes.say: Next time, open Provenance Wiki from your Applications folder or from Launchpad, like any other app.

scenes.caption: Something went wrong? Send us a screenshot and a short note
scenes.say: That's it. If anything goes wrong, take a screenshot, and send it to us with a short note. Thank you for testing Provenance Wiki.
